listed_for_build_unverified.name: Spindle VFD
listed_for_build_unverified.source_line: LinuxCNC Forum member ChrissyAG reports that they purchased a 1996 KRV2000 milling machine in 2020 for a CNC retrofit intended for disabled use. They had considered but rejected converting their earlier RF45-clone Chester Superlux mill because of its limited travel and rigidity. The KRV2000's electronics were initially on a test bench; the owner reports LinuxCNC 2.8 controlling spindle VFD, servo motors, and limit switches successfully during setup. The original Huangyang VFD was replaced in the test configuration with a Nflixin 9100 producing 380 V three-phase output, while the Huangyang VFD was used to keep the mill running manually during fabrication. The inspected search-indexed forum post does not establish final installation or commissioning.
